missions.title: First Day
missions.objective: Understand Novaris before learning procurement vocabulary.
missions.situation: Elena asks the learner to trace a real business need across the company before defining Procurement.

missions.title: How Does This Company Make Money?
missions.objective: Connect customer demand, revenue, cost and profit.
missions.situation: Trace a customer order from commercial promise to operational delivery and external spend.

missions.title: Where Does The Product Come From?
missions.objective: Discover supply chain by tracing a product backwards.
missions.situation: Follow a Novaris control unit from customer shipment back through production, warehouse, logistics and suppliers.

missions.title: Who Does What?
missions.objective: Recognize where Procurement begins, ends and collaborates.
missions.situation: Six colleagues bring six problems. Route ownership correctly and identify cross-functional handoffs.

missions.title: Why Procurement?
missions.objective: Identify Procurement value beyond order placement.
missions.situation: Compare five business requests and decide where Procurement involvement adds value.

missions.title: Procurement ≠ Purchasing
missions.objective: Distinguish transactional buying from the broader procurement lifecycle.
missions.situation: Two requests look alike. One is routine; one hides commercial, supplier and risk work.

missions.title: Direct or Indirect?
missions.objective: Classify direct and indirect spend from business context.
missions.situation: Classify requirements from production, IT, marketing and facilities without relying on memorized labels.

missions.title: The Laptop
missions.objective: Separate requested solution from underlying business need.
missions.situation: A stakeholder asks for a premium laptop urgently. Discover the actual requirement before buying anything.

missions.title: But I Need It Tomorrow
missions.objective: Handle urgency without bypassing governance blindly.
missions.situation: A genuine operational need conflicts with process timing and available stock.

missions.title: PR-10428
missions.objective: Read and investigate a purchase requisition.
missions.situation: PR-10428 requests 24 industrial connectors for Brno with a Friday need-by date.

missions.title: Approved
missions.objective: Understand what approval does and does not mean.
missions.situation: A requisition shows manager approval but Finance check is pending. Determine what can happen next.

missions.title: First Career Review
missions.objective: Demonstrate Trust 0 foundations without step-by-step prompting.
missions.situation: A mixed inbox tests whether the learner can orient, investigate, route and explain before acting.
